playpause.note: Glossy aqua button with a clear play icon, perfectly seated in the sweeping silver metal.

prev.note: Consistent glossy styling with clear legible icon.

next.note: Matches the aesthetic perfectly, nice lighting.

repeat.note: Well-integrated into the aqua shell, legible.

queue.note: Clear icon, glossy finish reads well as Frutiger Aero.

vol.note: Beautiful metallic radial gradient with distinct edge ridges and water droplets.

seek.note: Sleek recessed track with a distinct metallic thumb. Fill color is on-theme.

shuffle.note: Excellent use of the 'grass green' accent color as a faceted gem/glass toggle thumb.

visualizer.note: Glossy screen surface with a neat little LED-like strip at the bottom.

album_art.note: Large, clean glossy display area with nice diagonal reflections.

notes: Nailed the Frutiger Aero brief: the sky/clouds background, water droplets, and sweeping glossy aqua and silver shapes are perfect.
The glowing green accents add a great pop of color exactly where requested.
Material fidelity is excellent throughout, reading as thick, polished glass and brushed metal.
improve: The play/pause button currently only features a play triangle; including both a play and pause symbol or making it a toggle state would improve functional legibility.
A bit more depth/shadowing inside the seek slider track could make it look more physically recessed.
